references.text: The preceding verse describing the two onyx stones on which the names were to be engraved
The continuation describing how the stones were to be engraved and attached to the ephod as memorial stones
The list of the sons of Israel according to their birth order (כְּתוֹלְדֹתָם) that the names on the stones were to follow
An overview of Jacob's twelve sons who form the tribes of Israel, whose names were to be engraved
The fulfillment of this instruction when the ephod was actually made with the engraved stones
The new Jerusalem with twelve gates bearing the names of the twelve tribes of Israel, an eschatological parallel to the tribal names on the high priest's garment
This verse elaborates on the specific distribution of the names mentioned in 28:10 by confirming that all twelve tribes are represented as seals.
This verse confirms that the specific instruction regarding the order from 28:10 was followed exactly in the making of the breastpiece.
